newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads underperform again.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads underperform again.

text.p: Australian bonds underperformed U.S. and Canadian debt after the local market was sold off by overseas investors in after hours trading, although they stabilised in the dayside session on Friday.
The 10-year yields spread to the U.S. consolidated above the 100 basis points level after the brief tightening to the mid-80s on this week's unexpected easing in monetary policy.
However, despite the widening trend since then, the margin still remains below the highs seen at the start of the week.
The spread to New Zealand narrowed slightly as the market there braced itself ahead of next Tuesday's RBNZ monetary policy statement.
